description: This file contains utility functions for managing task list items within the Notesnook project, including counting checked items, deleting checked items, sorting list items, finding root task lists, and toggling child task items.

methods.name: countCheckedItems
methods.description: Counts the number of checked task items within a given ProsemirrorNode.

methods.name: deleteCheckedItems
methods.description: Deletes checked task items from a task list within a transaction at a specified position.

methods.name: sortList
methods.description: Sorts task list items based on their checked state within a transaction at a specified position.

methods.name: findRootTaskList
methods.description: Finds the root task list node closest to a given position, avoiding nested task lists and task items.

methods.name: toggleChildren
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of all descendant task items of a given node.
